mapper.select: SELECT option_id, question_id, option_text, option_value, sort_order, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at FROM tb_survey_option WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_survey_option ( option_id, question_id, option_text, option_value, sort_order, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{optionId}, #{questionId}, #{optionText}, #{optionValue}, #{sortOrder}, #{deleteYn}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_survey_option SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_at = NOW() WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_survey_option o JOIN tb_survey_question q ON q.question_id = o.question_id SET o.delete_yn = 'Y', o.updated_at = NOW() WHERE q.survey_id = #{surveyId} AND o.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_survey_option WHERE delete_yn = 'Y' AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
